newsitem.title: USA: Greenbriar, American Care to merge.
newsitem.headline: Greenbriar, American Care to merge.

text.p: Greenbriar Corp said Tuesday it had signed a preliminary agreement to acquire American Care Communities Inc in exchange for 1.3 million Greenbriar shares worth about $20 million.
After the merger, a total of 6.5 million Greenbriar shares will be outstanding.

Floyd Rhoades, chairman, president and chief executive officer of American Care Communities, will become president and chief executive officer of the combined companies. James Gilley, chairman, president and chief executive officer of Greenbriar, will be chairman.
Greenbriar said it expects the merger to be completed before year-end.
It said it has delayed previously announced plans to file with the Securities and Exchange Commission for an offering of up to 5,750,000 shares.
Greenbriar and American Care Communities together own or lease and manage 32 residences with about 2,650 units in 10 states.
